articles.title: Mallacoota's recycling champions win Tidy Towns Litter Award

check.note: Written by the publisher from East Gippsland Shire Council's announcement.

sources.title: Mallacoota's recycling champions score a Tidy Towns Litter Award

body: Some good news to start the month. Friends of Mallacoota and [Mallacoota Foreshore Holiday Park](/listing/mallacoota-foreshore-holiday-park.html) have won the 2026 Keep Australia Beautiful Victoria **Tidy Towns Litter Award** for their Container Deposit Scheme program. The award was presented this week at the Tidy Towns and Cities Sustainability Awards at Rydges Melbourne.
Anyone who has been here in January knows the problem. Our town of about 1,100 permanent residents can swell to as many as 10,000 people over summer, and the bins feel it.

The fix is simple and very Mallacoota. The holiday park puts out trailers where guests can drop their CDS-eligible cans and bottles. Friends of Mallacoota volunteers collect them and run them down to the town's container return point, and the refunds go towards conservation work in and around Croajingolong National Park.

It helps the return point too. Ours is one of the more remote in Victoria, and because the volunteers spread their collections across the year, it isn't swamped with a whole summer's worth of containers at once.
Congratulations to everyone involved, from the volunteers to the park staff and every camper who saved a can. And thanks to Keep Australia Beautiful Victoria for the recognition.
Source: [East Gippsland Shire Council on Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/eastgippyshire/), 1 October 2026.
